author: /root direct author
target: Eliminate supplied noise scale conditionally through projection ratios, while challenging rather than assuming the required error direction law.
target_class: bounded conditional mathematical construction and exposed-development model diagnostic
data_role: Both full 1335 X/Ka products were previously exposed. No independent empirical test. Later raw products remain unopened.
candidate_premises: Analog validation signal is one constant-complex-amplitude tone plus error.

Conditional on training, validation error has uniform complex-sphere direction, arbitrary positive radial distribution; this is a candidate supplier, not a derived physical law. Proper independent complex Gaussian white noise is a sufficient special case.
Ideal non-saturating unit half-width ADC cells in doubled-code units; full Euclidean outer radius sqrt(2N).
Training-derived reference frequency uses only first half and fixed FFT/optimizer rule. No full-record or validation frequency result is supplied to the training algorithm.
mathematical_route: Rank-two tone augmentation produces orthogonal energy-ratio F law at the true candidate frequency, eliminating unknown radial scale.
Quantizer-safe cone distance enlarges the acceptance region without estimating a physical deterministic noise bound.
Fixed-frequency amplitude disk follows by the same ratio geometry; any joint coverage must state levels and conditioning.

development_plan.primary_diagnostic: Residual autocovariance at fixed lags1,2,3,4,5,10,20 and pseudo-covariance after training-only frequency on validation; diagnostic correlations only, no exact p-value claim for fitted nuisance.
development_plan.nuisance_estimation: Validation complex amplitude may be projected out; its two real degrees and induced projection correlations are explicit.
development_plan.reference_comparison: Preserve both previously documented NCO time choices and both signs; no convention selected by data. Any validation statistic at tracking-implied frequency remains a conditional dependent-product diagnostic.
development_plan.exploratory_frequency_grid: Numerical accepted-set profiles are approximate, not rigorous continuous frequency exclusions or simultaneous confidence intervals.
development_plan.calibration_headers: Summarize FGAIN expected Px/No and IF-bandwidth settings; never reinterpret expected setup values as measured noise power.
development_plan.cross_record_dependence: No independence across records inferred; no pooling to a calibrated confidence bound without a separate supplier.
development_plan.no_clipping: All1200 fixed records retained including competing Ka peak; flags and extremes retained.

forbidden_imports: Calling a fitted residual an upper bound on physical noise
Deriving whiteness/proper Gaussianity from sample rate or bandwidth alone
Calling chosen symmetry a retired physical assumption
Inferring scalar signal from dependent receiver products
Treating this previously exposed window as held-out validation data
planned_synthetic_controls: Cone-distance constructive witness and lower bound
F-law coverage under Gaussian and non-Gaussian radial mixtures
No finite discrepancy bound without supplied law
